violations.DAILY_REST: {from} → {to}: only {hours} hours of rest between shifts — at least 11 hours are required (Labour Code 104.§).
violations.WEEKLY_REST: Week {week} of {year}: no continuous weekly rest of at least 48 hours (Labour Code 105–106.§).
violations.SIX_DAYS: {from} – {to}: {count} consecutive workdays — a rest day is mandatory after six days (Labour Code 105.§).
violations.PUBLISH_NOTICE: {date}: the schedule would be communicated only {hours} hours before the shift starts — the law requires at least 168 hours (7 days) (Labour Code 97.§ (4)).
violations.MODIFY_NOTICE: The published shift on {date} would change only {hours} hours before it starts — the law requires at least 96 hours, except at the employee's written request (Labour Code 97.§ (5)).

inv.title: Machines
inv.defaultProductHint: Machine-based settlement bills this machine's portions at this product's price. With a single stock product it applies without configuration.
inv.contractHint: Settlements compute these automatically: pro-rated rent + shortfall below the monthly minimum. Net prices.
inv.swapHint: The deployed machine goes to maintenance, the replacement is deployed to the same partner and inherits the contract terms.
inv.swapNotFound: No in-stock machine with that barcode.
inv.noPhotos: No photos of this machine yet.
inv.qrLabelsHint: Label sheet PDF for the selected machines — with no selection, for every machine in the list
inv.empty: No assets yet. Add the first one!
inv.qrLabelsSmallHint: For label printers (VOID label): one page per label, without partner name
inv.qrLabelsEzplHint: Native Godex label file (.ezp) for the 51×25 mm VOID label — open/send with GoLabel or raw-print directly.
inv.qrLabelsEzpxHint: GoLabel project file (.ezpx) using your own VOID label template: serial barcode + owner text, preconfigured for the G300 printer. Multiple machines download as a ZIP.
inv.normPerCounterHint: Per-counter norm: how many portions 1 kg of coffee yields on that counter. 0 = uses no coffee (e.g. hot chocolate) — keeps the kg check accurate.
inv.siteAddressHint: If the machine operates somewhere other than the partner's recorded address, enter the site — it OVERWRITES the partner's address on save (billing address stays), and route planning uses it from then on. Leave empty to change nothing.
inv.maintenanceFeeHint: Prefills the external maintenance worksheet — editable there; without the discount checkbox it is invoiced automatically after both signatures.
inv.godexHint: Labels are queued and the print agent running on the shop PC sends them straight to the Godex label printer.
inv.godexConfirm: QR labels for {count} machines will be queued for the Godex printer. Continue?
inv.godexQueued: {count} labels queued — the printer will produce them shortly.

wh.title: Warehouse
wh.empty: No warehouses yet — create the first one (e.g. a site and one van per rep).
wh.noStock: No stock in this warehouse yet.
wh.addProductHint: You pick manually which catalog products belong to this warehouse — the catalog and the warehouse assortment can differ.
wh.allProductsAssigned: Every active product is already assigned to this warehouse.
wh.productAdded: Product added to the warehouse (with 0 stock).
wh.productRemoved: Product removed from the warehouse assortment.
wh.deleteConfirm: Delete warehouse “{name}”? Its movement history is removed too — the audit log is kept.
wh.transferPendingCreated: Transfer recorded — waiting for the receiver's approval; the goods are “in transit”.
wh.transferAcceptConfirm: Confirm receipt? {product} — {qty} {unit} will be added to the warehouse.
wh.transferRejectConfirm: Reject this transfer ({product})? The quantity returns to the sender's warehouse.
wh.transferCancelConfirm: Cancel this transfer ({product})? The quantity returns to the warehouse.
wh.transfer_acceptDone: Receipt confirmed — stock added to the warehouse.
wh.transfer_rejectDone: Transfer rejected — stock returned to the sender.

contracts.title: Contracts
contracts.movedHint: Contract terms live in their own entity: a partner can have multiple contracts with validity periods; settlements always apply the one in force that day.
contracts.afterSaveHint: Contracts can be added after saving the partner.
contracts.hint: Settlements use the contract in force on the given day. Future contracts activate automatically; expired ones switch off.
contracts.empty: No contracts for this partner yet — settlements run without a minimum.
contracts.sumMinPortions: min. {n} portions/month ({price} Ft/portion for the shortfall)
contracts.sumMinKg: min. {n} kg/month ({price} Ft/kg for the shortfall)
contracts.sumRent: below minimum the rent fee is the penalty
contracts.noContractHint: These partners have deployed machines but no contract on file — worth fixing.
contracts.scheduleHint: The due list schedules by this frequency (same weekday, typically Tue–Thu); the payment method and terms are defaults at settlement/invoicing — they can be overridden there.
contracts.noMinimumHint: The partner always pays exactly what was brewed — contract AND machine-level minimums are disabled (unlimited grace period).

delivery.title: Delivery (delivery note)
delivery.hint: Hand over goods without a settlement — recorded on a digital delivery note (SZL number) and invoiced automatically on the partner's NEXT settlement. Any rep can record it for any partner.
delivery.needLine: Add at least one line (product + quantity).
delivery.created: Delivery note saved: {serial} — it will be invoiced at the next settlement.
delivery.openBanner: {count} open delivery note(s) ({net} Ft net) — this settlement will invoice them automatically.

agent.expensesHint: fuel, parking, supplies — deducted from the cash register

agent.substituteHint: During your approved leave/sickness, responsible-agent notifications are routed to them automatically.

cal.title: Calendar
cal.hint: The yearly decree's moved rest days and make-up working Saturdays. The system fetches next year automatically via AI and notifies you — verify/correct here. A monthly labor-code change check also runs.

cal.aiNothing: Nothing new to load (already present, or the AI doesn't know the decree yet).

worksheet.quote_already_accepted: The customer has already accepted this quote.
